overview_description.description:
Flowcarbon's versatile team merges investment banking, project finance, tax credit and other financial markets expertise to streamline access to creative capital solutions for the world’s most innovative companies in the infrastructure, decarbonization, and other niche sectors.
Flowcarbon is headquartered in New York, United States and was founded in 2021.

identifier.value: Dana Gibber Co-founder and CEO @ Flowcarbon

Toucan builds technology to unlock climate action at scale.
Moss.Earth is an environmental platform focused on developing innovative approaches to pursuing a sustainable environment.
Carbonplace is a carbon credit transaction network that will enable the secure, and transparent transfer of certified carbon credits.
CBL Markets is a global exchange providing market participants with access to the world’s environmental commodity markets.
Sylvera develops machine learning-based tools to track the performance of carbon offsets.
BeZero Carbon specializes in decarbonization, natural capital assessments, carbon credit ratings, and risk management services.
Patch focuses on building infrastructure for a climate-positive economy, starting with an API for carbon removal.

about_short_description.short_description: Flowcarbon uses blockchain technology to put carbon offset credits on-chain, accelerating the scalability of climate change solutions.

product.name: Project Finance Services
product.description: Provides customized debt financing solutions for engineered carbon removal projects to support their growth and scalability.

product.name: Tax Credit Services
product.description: Assists buyers and sellers with structuring and executing transferable tax credits related to renewable energy projects.

product.name: Carbon Credit Project Development
product.description: Evaluates and supports carbon removal projects to generate carbon credits, including eligibility assessment and project registration.

product.name: Carbon Credit Sales and Marketing
product.description: Facilitates the sale of carbon removal credits on spot markets and through long-term offtake agreements with corporate buyers.

product.name: Project Screening and Due Diligence
product.description: Conducts comprehensive evaluations of carbon removal projects, including financial, technological, and environmental risk assessments.
